<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex021032025-12-0316-40-29" status="unreviewed">'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bod ston pa 1</rs> na re || bden par 'dzin pa'i log shes rang gi ngo bo la || snang la don byed mi nus pa log pa'i kun rdzob || snang la don byed nus pa yang dag pa'i kun rdzob yin te
       <lb n="33a8"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3730"><expan>ye shes</expan> snying po</rs>'i zhal nas || <l>snang du 'dra yang don byed dag ||</l> <l>nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir ||</l> <l>yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i ||</l> <l>kun rdzob kyi ni dbye ba byas |</l> zhes pa ltar 'dod pa de mi 'thad de || log pa'i shes pa 'am yang
    <pb n="33b"/>
       <lb n="33b1"/>dag dang log pa'i dbye ba byas kyang | dgos pa <expan>med</expan> lam du mi 'gro ste | yang dag pa rang yang log shes yin pas so || </seg></TEI>
